question: Which of the following countries was elected as the President of the African-Asian Rural Development Organizaon for the Triennium 2025–2027 during its 21st General Session in February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India was elected as the President of the African-Asian Rural Development Organization (AARDO) for the triennium 2025–2027 during its 21st General Session in February 2025.
 
• AARDO is an inter-governmental organization aimed at promoting rural development in Africa and Asia through cooperation and collaboration among its member countries.
 
• India has been one of the founding members of AARDO and has played a significant role in its initiatives, particularly in capacity-building programs, technical assistance, and rural development projects.
 
• The election reflects India’s growing influence and leadership in fostering South-South cooperation for sustainable rural development.
 
• India’s presidency is expected to focus on enhancing agricultural productivity, rural poverty alleviation, and knowledge-sharing among the member countries of AARDO.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **African-Asian Rural Development Organization (AARDO)**

 
 
• AARDO was established in 1962 with the objective of promoting rural development in Africa and Asia through technical cooperation and resource sharing.
 
• The organization comprises 33 member countries from Africa and Asia and works on various rural development projects, including agriculture, education, health, and infrastructure.
 
• AARDO organizes training programs, workshops, and seminars to enhance the capacities of stakeholders in rural development.
 
• The organization fosters South-South cooperation and knowledge exchange among its member countries.
